OUR THINKING / 03

YOUR STYLE.
YOUR STORY.

A character can inspire the first build. After that, you decide what it becomes.

01 / STYLE

INSPIRED.
NOT COPIED.

Use your favourite element or colour as a starting point. You don't have to dress like a character to feel connected.

02 / CREATIVITY

GUIDED.
NOT LIMITED.

Start with a simple build, then experiment with shapes and combinations as your own taste develops.

03 / OWNERSHIP

KEEP IT.
OR REMIX IT.

Love the look you made? Keep it. Change it when you're ready. Your favourite piece doesn't have an expiry date.

WHAT WE HEARDWHAT WE CHANGED
01

Some familiar LEGO-like forms can feel too young or fixed for current teen style.

→

AGE UP THE FORM
More abstract, outfit-friendly geometry.

02

A guide can make the first DIY build easier, but teens still want choice.

→

GUIDE, THEN FREE UP
A starting design with room to personalise.

03

A finished piece they like can be worth keeping rather than immediately rebuilding.

→

KEEP, THEN EVOLVE
Rebuild when style changes—not on a schedule.

STUDENT DESIGN INTERPRETATIONS · NOT OFFICIAL NINJAGO BUILD RULES

For fans, there is meaning behind the colours. For new teens, the style can come first. Materials and modular reuse are possible responsible-design directions, not proven environmental claims.

NINJARTS / STUDENT PRODUCT CONCEPT

Created for the Hult Future Leaders Challenge 2026. NINJARTS is a proposed student design, not a manufactured or officially launched LEGO product. Images are concept visuals; colour options are digital explorations rather than validated products. Connection strength, material choices, exact part compatibility, safety and price remain unverified. No official LEGO endorsement, partnership or technical integration is claimed.
